claims: There are no known foods that contain the FTL1 (ferritin light chain 1) protein.
FTL1 is produced naturally in the brain.
FTL1 is not a dietary protein.
FTL1 is produced inside neurons especially in the hippocampus.
FTL1 levels are influenced by aging.
FTL1 levels are influenced by cellular stress.
FTL1 levels are influenced by metabolism.
FTL1 levels are not influenced by diet.
FTL1 is a type of iron-storage protein (ferritin).
Eating foods high in iron does not necessarily increase FTL1.
